description.subject: Young woman, around early-to-mid 20s, light tan / olive skin, very long voluminous tousled dark brown hair with lighter brown tones, strands falling across one eye and face, defined dark eyebrows, brown eyes, natural makeup with mauve-pink lips, small silver hoop earring

description.mood: Moody, confident, effortlessly cool, slightly seductive
